apiKey.title: novigapi.com API key
apiKey.description: Required. Free (100 credits a month, no card): https://novigapi.com/sign-up?utm_source=apify&utm_medium=actor&utm_campaign=novig-scraper. You can also set NOVIGAPI_KEY in the actor environment. No Novig account is needed.

league.title: League
league.description: Novig league code, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, NCAAF, NCAAB, WNBA, MLS, EPL, UFC, ATP, WTA.

market.title: Market
enumTitles: Game lines: moneyline, spread, total and team total

marketTypeCode.title: Novig market type code
marketTypeCode.description: Optional. One raw Novig market type such as POINTS, REBOUNDS or PASSING_YARDS; overrides Market.

includeFair.title: Include no-vig fair prices
includeFair.description: Adds fair_probability, fair_american and fair_decimal: the two-sided mid, (bid + 1 - other bid) / 2.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after this many outcome rows. Each page of 100 markets costs one credit on your own novigapi.com plan.
